TaskItem.title: TaskItem
TaskItem.description: A user's work task with deadline, priority, completion state, and reminder lead time.

notes.description: Optional work notes or checklist details (up to 500 characters).

deadlineMillis.description: Completion deadline timestamp in epoch milliseconds.

isCompleted.description: Whether the task has been completed.

completedAtMillis.description: Epoch milliseconds when completed, or 0 if incomplete.

category.description: Work category tag such as 工作, 会议, 沟通, 个人.

remindMinutesBefore.description: Minutes before deadline to trigger a reminder notification (0 to 1440).

createdAt.description: Server creation timestamp; clients must submit FieldValue.serverTimestamp().

updatedAt.description: Server last-updated timestamp; clients must submit FieldValue.serverTimestamp().

/users/{userId}/tasks/{taskId}.description: Per-user work tasks synced in real time across devices.
